name: lizzard-writer
description: Brief in, reel script out: lizard-brain hook (danger or happy), then a surprisingly simple twist.

interface.shortDescription: Brief in, shoot-ready reel script out.
interface.longDescription: Turns a content brief (source, idea, topic, product) into a reel script that is ready to shoot: a danger-mode or happy-mode hook, an open loop, small concrete levers, and a true 'ternyata cuma gitu' twist. Timed beat table, on-screen text, voice-over block, caption and alt hooks for testing.
defaultPrompt: Write a reel script with lizzard-writer from this brief.
